items.text: Create roles/dotfiles/ standard layout; top-level playbook.yml targets localhost, connection: local via ansible.cfg, no inventory needed.
Session-daemon evals (gpg-agent, mise activate) stay in bash_profile/zshrc; ssh-agent wiring out of scope (#155).
Dotfiles move to roles/dotfiles/files/, linked via file state: link force: yes; back up regular files first (#41).
Split tasks into tagged files: dirs, links, terminfo, gpg, ssh, tpm, prereqs, rust, mise, claude_opencode, npm, brew, brew_casks, nvim, zoxide, beads, upgrade.
ssh: openssh_keypair rsa 4096 + ed25519, no passphrase; macOS config via blockinfile '# BEGIN/END dotfiles' markers (#45).
ssh keeps macOS ssh-add --apple-use-keychain preload; drop dead Linux inline ssh-agent eval.
brew: keep tmux --HEAD + pin (#138), git-delta reinstall guard, Linux gcc; brew bundle --global if ~/.Brewfile.
dotfiles_state present (default, install-only) | latest includes upgrade.yml covering module and command-based upgrades of all tools.
defaults vars: dotfiles_brew_core, dotfiles_brew_linux, dotfiles_brew_macos, dotfiles_mise_tools, dotfiles_npm_globals, dotfiles_ssh_key_email, dotfiles_home.
Platform conditionals only: ansible_system == 'Darwin', ansible_os_family Debian / Archlinux; no custom fact gathering.
Out of scope: GPG key generation, ~/.ssh/api_keys, Vault, subsuming #152, changing lib/ or bats unit tests.
Residual ~30-line bootstrap.sh: self-clone to ~/dev/dotfiles, Linux brew prereqs, install brew+ansible, exec playbook.
bootstrap.sh success message to print after the playbook run.
items.exact: open a new login shell (or: exec $SHELL -l) so mise/gpg-agent/brew/cargo PATH take effect

items.text: Role prereqs adds zlib1g-dev xdg-utils bash-completion, apt update_cache every run; apt upgrade only when latest.
Molecule with idempotence + goss verifier; Dockerfile runs ansible-playbook; just install/upgrade forward extra args.
